title: FLARE MCMC: Fidelity-based Layer-Adaptive REcursive proposals for MCMC
abstract: arXiv:2608.13774v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) requires only the ability to evaluate the likelihood, making it a common technique for inference in complex models. However, it can have a slow mixing rate, requiring the generation of many samples to obtain good estimates and an overall high computational cost. FLARE MCMC is a multi-fidelity layered MCMC method that exploits lower-fidelity approximations of the true likelihood calculation to improve mixing and leads to overall faster performance. Such lower-fidelity likelihoods are commonly available in scientific and engineering applications where the model involves a simulation whose resolution or accuracy can be tuned. Our technique uses recursive, layered chains with simple layer tuning; it does not require the likelihood to take any form or have any particular internal mathematical structure. We demonstrate experimentally that FLARE MCMC achieves larger effective sample sizes for the same computation

translated_title: FLARE MCMC：基于保真度的层自适应递归提议用于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法
translated_abstract: 马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法仅需评估似然函数的能力，因此常用于复杂模型的推断。然而，其混合速率可能较慢，需要生成大量样本才能获得良好的估计，导致总体计算成本较高。FLARE MCMC是一种多保真度分层MCMC方法，利用真实似然计算的低保真度近似来改善混合，并实现整体更快的性能。在科学和工程应用中，模型涉及可调节分辨率或精度的模拟时，这种低保真度似然通常可用。我们的技术采用递归、分层链，具有简单的层调谐；它不要求似然函数具有特定形式或内部数学结构。我们通过实验证明，在相同计算量下，FLARE MCMC能实现更大的有效样本量。
tldr: FLARE MCMC通过递归分层和多保真度近似似然，在不需特定结构的情况下提升MCMC混合效率，显著增加相同计算下的有效样本量。
en_tdlr: FLARE MCMC uses recursive layered chains with multi-fidelity likelihood approximations to improve MCMC mixing without requiring specific structure, significantly increasing effective sample size per computation.
